Q020.reason: The Marshall Plan (1948) was US economic aid to rebuild postwar Europe.

Q021.reason: NSC 68 (1950) called for a major US military buildup, a shift from economic toward military containment.

Q022.reason: The Monroe Doctrine (1823) warned European powers to stay out of the Western Hemisphere, including Latin America.

Q023.reason: The Truman Doctrine (1947) made resisting communism a global commitment, so US policy began viewing local revolts through a geopolitical lens.

Q024.reason: A multipolar system has three or more major powers, while bipolar has two and unipolar has one.
